k:形.mnemonic: A painter's frame lashed from sticks, three (三) rails and twenty (廾) joints, and beside it a brush of whiskers (彡) tracing the outline of whatever shows through. Shape (form, style, manner).

k:進.mnemonic: A turkey (隹) on the path (辶). A turkey cannot walk backwards, so the only way it ever goes is forward. Advance (progress, proceed, promote).
k:進.hint: A bird that only goes forward.

k:治.mnemonic: A tsunami (氵) of floodwater is held back by a ruler on a pedestal (台). Whoever tames the water brings peace and rules the land. Reign (govern, cure, heal).

k:我.mnemonic: A hand (手) grips a halberd (戈) and waves it about: look at me, look at my weapon! Ego (I, selfish, our).

k:義.mnemonic: A sheep (羊) is placed above the ego (我): the self bows down beneath an offering for others. Putting the flock first. Righteousness (justice, morality, honor).
k:義.hint: The self bowed under an offering.

k:議.mnemonic: Round the table, everyone gets to say (言) what they think righteousness (義) demands, back and forth, before anything is decided. Deliberation (discussion, consult, consultation).
k:議.hint: Arguing what's right round a table.

k:半.mnemonic: A stick (｜) drops between a pair of horns (丷) and divides everything below: two (二) rails cut through the middle, ten (十) coins shared five and five. Half (middle, odd number, semi-).
k:半.hint: A stick splitting everything down the middle.

k:問.mnemonic: A mouth (口) at the gate (門): someone leaning in through the gateway to ask whether anyone is home. Question (ask, problem, inquiry).

k:団.mnemonic: A fence (囗) built to an exact measurement (寸), just big enough to hold the members. Everyone inside the fence belongs. Association (group, body, organization).
k:団.hint: A fence sized for its members.

k:八.mnemonic: Two fins (ハ) leaning away from each other. Picture an octopus spreading its arms out to both sides, and count the arms. Eight.

k:他.mnemonic: The leader (亻) finds a scorpion (也) in the tent and steps back: not me, let somebody else pick it up. Other (another, the others, others).
k:他.hint: Somebody else can grab the scorpion.

k:利.mnemonic: A knife (刂) cutting ripe grain (禾): the harvest is what you gain from a year of work. Profit (advantage, benefit).

k:注.mnemonic: A tsunami (氵) of water for the master (主): the servant tips the jug into his cup, watching closely so that not a drop spills. Pour (note, attention, irrigate).

k:虫.mnemonic: A fat body with a round head and a little flick of tail at the bottom: a bug, or a tiny snake coiled up. Insect (bug, temper).
k:虫.hint: A fat little body with a tail.

k:声.mnemonic: A samurai (士) stands over a flag (尸) and shouts his orders across the field, so loudly that the flag flutters. Voice.
k:声.hint: A shout that shakes the flag.

k:強.mnemonic: An insect (虫) bursts out of its cocoon (厶) and bends a bow (弓) all by itself: a beetle that can lift many times its own weight. Strong (strength, powerful).

k:投.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) let go of a weapon (殳): the javelin leaves the hand and sails through the air. Throw (discard, abandon, launch into).

k:終.mnemonic: You trudge (夂) through the snow following a thread (糸) until the spool runs out and there is no more to follow. End (finish, ending).

k:制.mnemonic: Each cow (牛) is wiped with a towel (巾) and trimmed with a knife (刂), always in that order, every cow the same way: fixed rules. System (control, rule, law).
k:制.hint: Every cow handled the same way.

k:参.mnemonic: A cat's whiskers (彡) poke out of a cocoon (厶) of blankets: it wants to see what everyone is doing and join in. Participate (go, visit, attend).
k:参.hint: Whiskers poking out to join in.

k:続.mnemonic: A merchant sells (売) thread (糸) by the length. He keeps pulling it off the spool, on and on, without a break. Continue (series, sequel, continuation).

k:集.mnemonic: A turkey (隹) lands on a tree (木), and then the whole flock flaps in to roost beside it. Gather (collect, meet, congregate).
k:集.hint: A flock roosting on one tree.

k:能.mnemonic: Shut in a cocoon (厶) for a month (月) with two spoons (匕), you come out able to juggle them. Practice turns into talent. Ability (talent, skill, capacity).

k:皮.mnemonic: A hand with a blade working under an animal hide that hangs over a rail, peeling it away. Pelt (skin, hide, leather).
k:皮.hint: A hide hung over a rail.

k:彼.mnemonic: Someone out for a stroll (彳) wearing a pelt (皮). You point across the road: who is that man in the fur, him over there? He (that, him).

k:周.mnemonic: A wall facing (向) inwards runs all the way round a patch of soil (土). Walk along it and you come back to where you started. Circumference (circuit, lap).

k:判.mnemonic: A knife (刂) cuts the disputed thing in half (半): the judge has ruled, each side gets a share, and the seal goes on the paper. Judgement (seal, stamp, signature).
k:判.hint: The judge cuts it in two.

k:調.mnemonic: Say (言) one note to each player all around the circumference (周) of the orchestra, checking every instrument in turn until they match. Tune (investigate, tone, check).

k:谷.mnemonic: Two pairs of slopes opening downward like hillsides, with a mouth-shaped gap at the bottom where the stream runs out. Valley.
